scene_sienna_00_intro.text: Sienna Brooks is posted up at the bar, framed in warm golden light. Even in the crowd, there’s an orbit around her — people drawn to the way she laughs, listens, and fills the space without trying. Up close, the impression is sharper: fiery pop star with a big heart. If you walk over now, the way you approach will set the tone.
